event: UI: Back / Esc out of a menu
what plays now: mostly none (moving inside a menu blips; leaving it is usually silent)

event: UI: Confirm a dialog (Yes / No)
what plays now: blip, the same as any menu move

event: UI: Toast messages (saved, copied, link copied)
what plays now: none (an achievement toast plays best)

event: Career calendar: A new month, Ramadan, Eid or a holiday starting
what plays now: none

event: Currency: Halal Bucks and Barakah earned after a game (the summary)
what plays now: none

event: Trivia: The answer timer running low
what plays now: none

event: Hot spot: A hot spot appearing on the floor
what plays now: none

event: Shot clock: The last seconds of the shot clock
what plays now: none (only the violation buzzer)

event: Free throws: Stepping to the line, each attempt
what plays now: none (the foul whistle before it)

event: Period: The halftime screen
what plays now: none of its own (the period-end buzzer before it)

event: Results: The final screen, a win
what plays now: none of its own (the final buzzer and cheer before it)

event: Results: The final screen, a loss
what plays now: none of its own (the final buzzer before it)

event: Ambience: Neighbourhood scenes (home, street, masjid front, store)
what plays now: none

event: Ambience: Inside the masjid: musalla, office, the Jumu’ah room
what plays now: none

event: Ambience: The career hub
what plays now: none

event: Ambience: Menus over the attract match
what plays now: that match’s crowd (the classic arena: tier 4)

event: Ambience: The practice gym
what plays now: none (v9.13: no crowd bed there any more)

event: Mini games: Lightning: a fed ball caught (SFX.catch)
what plays now: none: the code calls SFX.catch, which doesn’t exist

event: Crowd: A turnover
what plays now: v9.13: a groan from the people drawn (silent when nobody is drawn)

event: Crowd: A block
what plays now: v9.13: an "ooh" from the people drawn

event: Crowd: A bad miss
what plays now: v9.13: a groan from the people drawn (they already put their hands on their heads)
